text:
Updated `.sdlc/runs/20261105-000000-feature-new-rich-text-spans/requirements.md` and handed it in via `write_requirements`:

1. **Removed off-contract file references**: Removed `packages/element/src/stickyNote.ts`, `packages/element/src/comparisons.ts`, and `packages/element/src/showSelectedShapeActions.ts` from In-scope item 3 and `FR-9`; all requirements now exclusively reference files within the frozen write contract from `intent_brief.md`.
2. **Specified initial full-text auto-select behaviour (`FR-8.1`, `FR-9.1`, `FR-9.3`, `AC-1.3`, and In-scope item 3)**: Defined explicitly that the automatic full-text `editable.select()` run on editor mount does **not** count as an active inline range selection, so picking a colour immediately after opening the editor (under initial auto-select or a collapsed caret `start === end`) applies element-wide / sticky-note colour targets, whereas an inline range selection becomes active only when `0 <= selectionStart < selectionEnd <= originalText.length` is set via `initialSelection` or changed after editor mount.
